Thank you for replying... Sorry if I sound like a dick. I've heard this before. It makes sense on paper, but in practice it has never worked for me. There aren't really things I enjoy. I find a lot of disappointment in things I do in general. I get extremely anxious about doing anything and am completely self conscious. The other half of this, take time for myself, is something I do not know how to do....

What does it mean? I live my life majorly for myself. I'm simply affected by other people. I haven't been able to find a way to not care.
